# test-report.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow Test report.</link-summary>

```text
Turns the JSON test reports that dart-ci.yml and flutter-ci.yml upload with test-report-enabled
(artifacts davils-test-reports-*) into a check run with an annotation for every failed test.
Call it after those workflows in the same run. It is a separate workflow because it needs
checks: write, which the test jobs themselves do not.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  test-report:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/test-report.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact-pattern` | string | `davils-test-reports-*` | Pattern of the report artifacts. |
| `name` | string | `Tests` | Name of the check run. |
| `reporter` | string | `auto` | dart-json or flutter-json; auto picks it from the artifact names. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `checks: write`
- `contents: read`
